PR-20.reason: Add Muse colors, filters, names, handoff, read/ask/edit job controls and owner chat composer. The optional mobile page and default mobile activation behavior are unchanged.

AB-383.reason: AB-383: the dashboard subscribes to GET /api/events while the tab is visible and reads the shown chat or run at once when the history store reports new lines; pushes coalesce into one render and interval polling stays as the safety net; after an error, a visible tab retries the stream (1c75687f, page re-pinned). The optional mobile page and default mobile activation behavior are unchanged.

AB-400.reason: AB-400 (PR #92): outcomeChip adds a constant-text "result stored" / "result stored, not delivered" / "delivered" chip from state.jobs[job].resultStored and the job outcome's delivery receipt; poll() and loadOlder() merge job flags from older /api/runs pages (olderJobs). Page re-pinned from d9a04493 to ada58414. The optional mobile page and default mobile activation behavior are unchanged.

AB-398.reason: AB-398: the desktop dashboard script shows a paused subagent job: "paused" becomes a known pill status styled like interrupted, a paused group keeps its place with the working ones, shows its pause reason and time in the row and conversation note, offers a resume_subagent hint, and the counts line adds "N paused" (6c3430d1, page re-pinned). The mobileDashboardPage addition, the optional mobile page and default mobile activation behavior are unchanged. Merged on top of AB-400 (PR #92): AB-400's outcomeChip now also runs for a paused group (it is not running), so it reads state.jobs only once state is loaded; the result-stored chip is otherwise unchanged.
